# klaviyo Provider

Provider for managing Klaviyo resources via the Klaviyo REST API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    klaviyo = {
      source  = "aroma-zone/klaviyo"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# Recommended: feed credentials through environment variables so they
# don't end up in tfstate or shell history.
#   export KLAVIYO_API_KEY="pk_..."
#   export KLAVIYO_API_REVISION="2026-04-15.pre"  # optional override
provider "klaviyo" {
  # api_key, api_revision, and base_url can all be set here too if
  # you prefer explicit configuration.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Klaviyo private API key. Falls back to the `KLAVIYO_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `api_revision` (String) Klaviyo API revision (e.g. `2026-04-15`). Falls back to `KLAVIYO_API_REVISION`, then to the revision this provider was built against.
- `base_url` (String) Override the Klaviyo API base URL. Defaults to `https://a.klaviyo.com`.
